svg.title: Parameter-event map for a changed polynomial family
svg.desc: A staged construction for G_t(x)=x(x+3)((t-2)x^2+(t+1)). Stage one shows the factor structure. Stage two adds the degree-drop test. Stage three adds the real-root existence boundary. Stage four adds the collision test with the fixed root negative three. It teaches which event equations to derive before splitting parameter cases.

g.text: Start from factors. Fixed roots are visible; the last factor controls extra roots and degree.
When can an extra root equal −3?
Only after deriving all event values: order them, then test one point per open interval.
The event equations, not sampled values, make the case split exhaustive.
